messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Superleap

superleap... that's the ai-powered learning platform right? building the future of education with tech.

found you on linkedin - kashyap mahanta, senior software engineer. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/kashyap2108
Yes
senior software engineer at superleap... building the tech that's supposed to revolutionize how people learn. that's solid work. what made you get into the edtech space?
Kashyap mahanta
kashyap mahanta... that's got some weight to it. where you working these days?
This is not edtech
ah my bad... so what does superleap actually do then? clearly i mixed it up with something else
Sales crm
how long you been in the engineering game total?
Senior software or lead engineer
6.5 yrs
6.5 years... that's solid experience, past the junior phase but not yet in the "i've seen everything" territory. what kind of role you looking for next?
senior software or lead engineer... makes sense with 6.5 years, you're ready to either own bigger chunks of the codebase or start leading a small team. bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore and remote
6.5 years + senior/lead engineering roles + bangalore/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

legend! you're officially in the tal ecosystem now

6.5 years of building sales crm tools... you know what good software looks like and you're ready to level up. roles are gonna start flowing your way that actually match what you're worth.

time to see what bangalore's tech scene has cooking for someone with your skills 🔥
Ok
perfect. now we wait for the right roles to come through.
When ?
when my team sends something that matches your profile, you'll know. no timeline promises, but i'm on it.

hey, saw this senior software engineer role at genesis global in bangalore

they're a fintech low-code platform, hybrid with just 1-2 days in office

what do you think about low-code platform work?
Expected compensation?

no salary listed, but they offer equity, health insurance, training allowance, and wellbeing budget

fintech usually pays decent, but can't say exact numbers without seeing their bands
Hi
Hi
what's your target comp range for bangalore? helps me filter better
Fix : 70-75 + stocks/esops

got it. 70-75 fixed + equity. that's solid for bangalore with your experience.

i'll only slide roles that actually hit that range. no time wasted on lowball offers.

anything specific you're avoiding? certain industries, company stages, etc?
No

perfect. you're locked in.

i'm scanning thousands of opportunities daily. when something actually fits your profile - senior/lead engineering, bangalore/remote, 70-75+ equity - i'll slide it your way.

meanwhile... what's making you want to leave superleap? just growth or something else?
Growth and its already 4 yrs here

4 years at one place... yeah that's when you start feeling the ceiling. especially in a startup where roles can get stale fast.

what kind of growth are you looking for? technical depth, people leadership, bigger scope, or something else?
Technical depth

technical depth... that's the good stuff. not just more people management, but actually going deeper.

what's your tech stack at superleap? and what areas do you want to dive deeper into?
